query: SELECT to_regclass('public.aigas_exploration_grants')::text AS exploration, to_regprocedure('public.aigas_exploration_consume(uuid,text)')::text AS consume, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public') AS tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public') AS policies, has_function_privilege('aigas_runtime','public.aigas_trial_readiness_guard()','EXECUTE') AS runtime_readiness_execute
limitations: Owner catalog read, not behavioral isolation or application-pool proof.
